config.grain_rationale: One record is a provider's service site (outlet): the location at which an employment-services provider delivers a named contract (DESA, DESB, EPS5, TTW5, NEI5, RJCP...). The same physical site recurs once per contract (e.g. site A300 appears under both DESA and DESB), so the grain is site x contract, not a legal entity. The business attributes mapped here (name, website, address) are those of the provider operating that site; the file carries no ABN/ACN or registered legal name.

record_id.rationale: DIS_SITE_CODE alone is not unique (489 distinct in 505 discovery rows) because a site is repeated once per contract; the (DIS_SITE_CODE, CONTRACT_NAME) pair is the natural key of one provider site under one contract.

fields.rationale: SITE_NAME holds the provider organisation's trading/brand name as published in the provider directory (e.g. 'MAX Employment', 'Advanced Personnel Management (APM)', 'Sarina Russo Job Access', 'CoAct/Community Solutions'). These are business/display names, not registered legal names, and the source has no legal-name, ABN or ACN column to establish the registered entity, so trading_name is the correct target rather than legal_name.
SITE_URL is the provider's web address (present on 57.6% of discovery rows, 88 distinct domains such as www.apm.net.au, www.sureway.com.au), mostly without scheme; website op normalises this.
Composed full address of the provider site from the street address line, locality, state code and postcode; all four components are present on 100% of discovery rows.
SITE_LOCALITY_NAME is the suburb/locality of the site's street address (100% present, 412 distinct AU localities such as HEALESVILLE, IPSWICH).
SITE_STATE_CD is the site's Australian state/territory abbreviation (8 distinct values: NSW, VIC, QLD, SA, WA, TAS, NT, ACT).
SITE_POSTCODE is the site's 4-digit Australian postcode; 13 discovery values are 3 digits and are NT postcodes with a dropped leading zero (postcode op re-pads).

No ABN/ACN/NZBN, legal-name, entity-type, entity-status or date columns exist, so no identifier, entity_type, status, date_registered or observation validity dates can be asserted. holdout_issues.message: 7 holdout records share a key built from ['DIS_SITE_CODE', 'CONTRACT_NAME']; choose unique key columns or content_hash

fields.reason: SITE_NAME contains provider display/brand names (e.g., 'Vision Australia', 'NOVA Employment') rather than registered legal names. Mapping to entity.trading_name is correct given the absence of a legal name or ABN/ACN source.
SITE_URL maps correctly to entity.website. The website op appropriately normalises values with and without schemes, as verified in held-out records.
Concatenation of street, locality, state, and postcode into address.full is appropriate for this dataset's grain (service site). Components are consistently present and correctly ordered.
SITE_LOCALITY_NAME accurately maps to address.locality. Values correspond to suburbs/towns and match the full address composition.
SITE_STATE_CD maps correctly to address.state enum. All observed values (ACT, NSW, NT, QLD, VIC, SA) are valid Australian state/territory codes.
SITE_POSTCODE maps correctly to address.postcode. The postcode op successfully re-pads 3-digit NT postcodes (e.g., '850' -> '0850') as evidenced in held-out record BK20.
Constant 'AU' for address.country is justified by the dataset publisher (Australian Government DEWR) and exclusive presence of Australian state codes.

critic.summary: All mapping rules are correct and well-justified. The mapping appropriately targets trading_name over legal_name given the source constraints, handles address components including NT postcode padding correctly, and uses valid constants. No ontology targets were missed; unmapped columns (phone, email, coordinates, contract codes) correctly lack corresponding ontology fields or are not business attributes.

config.notes: Header has a trailing comma, producing an empty 19th field (column_18) - ignored. No ABN/ACN/NZBN, legal-name, entity-type, entity-status or date columns exist, so no identifier, entity_type, status, date_registered or observation validity dates can be asserted. SITE_NAME appears truncated at 30 characters in places (e.g. 'Auctus Business Training and Consul', 'Campbell Page MORELAND/'), so trading names may be incomplete. Some SITE_URL cells hold phone numbers or text such as 'TTY: 03 96143062', which are dropped by the domain regex rather than emitted as websites. Held-out validation showed (DIS_SITE_CODE, CONTRACT_NAME) is not unique, so record_id now uses a content hash over all source columns.

fields.reason: SITE_NAME correctly maps to entity.trading_name as the source contains provider brand/display names (e.g., 'Vision Australia', 'NOVA Employment') and explicitly lacks legal names or business identifiers. The rationale accurately distinguishes trading name from legal name.

SITE_URL maps to entity.website with appropriate cleaning. The regex_extract step correctly filters out non-URL values like phone numbers observed in the source, and the website op normalizes the domain. Held-out records confirm correct extraction including handling of schemes.

address.full is correctly composed from SITE_ADDRESS_LN, SITE_LOCALITY_NAME, SITE_STATE_CD, and SITE_POSTCODE. All components are present in held-out records and the concatenation produces valid full addresses without postal/premises confusion.

SITE_LOCALITY_NAME correctly maps to address.locality. Values in held-out records (e.g., CANBERRA, WAGGA WAGGA, Gayndah) are valid Australian localities/suburbs corresponding to site premises addresses.
SITE_STATE_CD correctly maps to address.state using the state op for normalization. All held-out values (ACT, NSW, NT, QLD, VIC, SA) are valid enum members and correspond to site locations.

SITE_POSTCODE correctly maps to address.postcode with the postcode op handling zero-padding. Held-out record BK20 confirms '850' is correctly normalized to '0850' for NT postcodes. All other postcodes are valid 4-digit AU postcodes.

Constant 'AU' for address.country is correct given this is an Australian Government (DEWR) dataset with exclusively Australian state codes and postcodes. No evidence of non-Australian sites in held-out records.

critic.summary: All 7 mapping rules are correct. SITE_NAME is appropriately mapped to trading_name (not legal_name) given the source lacks registered names or ABN/ACN. Website extraction handles dirty data correctly. Address components are properly decomposed and normalized, including NT postcode zero-padding. The constant country value is justified. Unmapped columns are correctly excluded: DIS_SITE_CODE and CONTRACT_NAME are site/contract identifiers not business attributes; phone/email fields have no ontology targets; ESA codes are geographic descriptors not industry codes; coordinates lack ontology support. No missed mappings identified.
